; ===========================================================================
; FX30 camera trigger - Timelapse G-code box (single tapering wall)
;
; A straight, honest note on what this is and isn't: the gcode you sent
; shows Orca's real tower using its "Rib" wall type - hundreds of tiny
; (~0.07mm) segments per layer tracing smooth rounded bumps, generated by
; Orca's own internal curve/boolean-shape engine. That's not something I
; can reverse-engineer from the raw gcode into a formula, it's proprietary
; slicer logic, not a documented shape. Hand-typing an exact copy would
; mean hundreds of individually computed micro-segments per layer, for
; every layer of the whole print - not something I can build reliably or
; that you could realistically maintain afterward.
;
; What I built instead is the same SPIRIT of shape: rounded (no sharp
; corners), built from plain G1 line segments (not G2/G3 arcs - Orca's own
; tower doesn't use arc commands in your gcode either, it tessellates
; everything into straight lines itself, which strongly suggests this
; Klipper build isn't guaranteed to have arc support enabled, so this
; matches that same safe approach). (Note for future edits to this box:
; Orca's custom-gcode parser treats square brackets as its own old
; placeholder syntax, even inside comments - avoid square brackets
; anywhere in this file, parentheses are safe.)
;
; FIX from the last two attempts: attempt 1 was a single-layer brim, too
; thin to see or matter. Attempt 2 fixed the height but added a SEPARATE
; extra ring floating around the normal body - so early layers had two
; disconnected walls instead of one tapering wall, which read as "another
; wall" rather than a taper. This version is a single wall system, one
; outer loop + one inner loop + infill per layer, whose size itself
; shrinks in four steps as height increases - the SAME wall gets
; narrower, nothing extra bolted on beside it. Like a tree trunk widening
; toward its base, just approximated with a few discrete steps instead of
; one smooth curve, since hand-computing a truly continuous taper (a
; different set of coordinates for every single layer, all the way up
; the print) isn't practical to build or verify by hand.
;
; Geometry, centered on (246, 265), one band selected per layer by Z:
;   Z <= 0.3   (~layer 1)    : outer 14mm r3.5 / inner 12mm r3.0
;   Z <= 0.65  (~layers 2-3) : outer 12mm r3.0 / inner 10mm r2.5
;   Z <= 1.0   (~layers 4-5) : outer 10mm r2.5 / inner  8mm r2.0
;   else       (rest of print): outer 8mm r2.0 / inner  6mm r1.5
; infill fills whichever inner loop is active that layer, 7 lines, 0.6mm
; inset from the inner wall. Same caveat as before - double check in
; Orca's preview that this footprint (roughly X239-253, Y258-272) doesn't
; clip your model, I can't see your actual bed layout for the current
; shape.
;
; Extrusion calibrated for 0.2mm layer height / 0.42mm line width / 1.75mm
; filament (E per mm = 0.0349mm) - recompute if you change layer height.
;
; No ;BEFORE_LAYER_CHANGE marker or G92 E0 here - the profile inserts
; those automatically regardless of what's in this box, same for
; TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME / DEFECT_DETECTION_DETECT.
; ===========================================================================

; ---------------- FX30 camera trigger + purge pad ----------------
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=fx30      ; remember position, feedrate and E mode
M83                              ; relative extrusion
G1 E-0.8 F2400                   ; retract, leaving the object clean
G91
G1 Z2 F1200                      ; lift 2mm clear of the print before
                                  ; heading over to the pad
G90

{if layer_z <= 0.3}

; ---- camera trigger (same switch sequence as before) ----
G1 E-0.8 F2400                     ; retract before heading to the switch
G1 X250 Y265 F18000                ; fast diagonal to the approach point
G1 X262.8 Y265 F6000                ; press the switch -> camera triggered
M400                                 ; wait for the move to actually finish
G4 P100                              ; hold the contact closed

G1 X248 Y265 F6000                    ; back off - lands right next to the
                                       ; pad, off the object
M400
G4 P2000                              ; hold still while the shutter fires

M83
G1 E0.8 F2400                         ; un-retract, ready to resume printing

RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=fx30 MOVE=1 MOVE_SPEED=300
; the move above returns to the resume point on the object
; -------------- end FX30 camera trigger + purge pad --------------
